deals.offer: 京东外卖补贴回落后仍可真实抵扣的组合：整点放出的大额金券满29减20，可与满4减3、满5减4等小额券叠加使用；PLUS会员另有每日限量外卖餐补，赛事期间JDG获胜还会发放19减15大券。
deals.offerEn: After JD food-delivery subsidies were reduced, this combination can still be used for real savings: a large gold coupon for ¥20 off orders over ¥29, released on the hour, can be stacked with small coupons such as ¥3 off orders over ¥4 and ¥4 off orders over ¥5. PLUS members also get a daily limited food-delivery meal subsidy, and when JDG wins a match, a ¥15-off-¥19 coupon is released.
deals.offerZh: 京东外卖补贴回落后仍可真实抵扣的组合：整点放出的大额金券满29减20，可与满4减3、满5减4等小额券叠加使用；PLUS会员另有每日限量外卖餐补，赛事期间JDG获胜还会发放19减15大券。
deals.riskEn: Gold coupons and the PLUS meal subsidy are limited and available while stocks last. Prepaid food-delivery cards and top-up packs have recently drawn complaints about deductions when cancelling, so buy them with caution.
deals.riskNote: 金券和PLUS餐补均为限量，抢完即止；需预存的外卖饭卡、随心囤近期有退卡扣费投诉，建议谨慎购买。
